cli_stage_request.input: Existing A/B/C exports and the current validated D generation under the requested output root.
cli_stage_request.behavior: Render only saved versioned exports. Do not dispatch A/B/C/D, fit models, or access network resources.

report_bundle_contract.source_binding: A/B/C envelopes are bound to the exact fixed payload filename and SHA256; D is bound to the validated current pointer, generation manifest, payload, and envelope bytes.
report_bundle_contract.render_identity: The report identity binds source hashes, config hash, main Quarto template, stylesheet, fixed target/clinical section templates, rendering policy, and effective R/package/Quarto/platform/source revision.

provider_return_shape.reason_code: One scalar string; use a stable code or an empty string.
provider_return_shape.tables: A named list of data.frames. Cell text is escaped and path/credential-sanitized by the shared report renderer. Do not include direct identifiers or raw clinical free text.

fixed_section_composition.defaults: When a provider or packaged section template is absent, the report renders an explicit not-implemented/unavailable section. No user-provided include, plugin, or code chunk is accepted.

integration_request: Sol applies the public export/manual entry and serial report-stage registry/CLI changes. Preserve the report-specific exit mapping above, return the renderer's exit_code, and write the report directory beneath the existing output root. Review the resulting CLI behavior with this candidate before acceptance.
